AboutDescription: Local-first multi-format diagram editor: editing, live preview, image export and copy. Supports Mermaid (.mmd / .mermaid), Graphviz DOT (.dot / .gv), drawio (.drawio) and Excalidraw (.excalidraw). The AI assistant works with your own API key or through the membership cloud gateway (including image recognition). Rendering and syntax checks run entirely on this machine.

Recognizing an image requires uploading it to Diagramon Cloud, which forwards it to the model service.

The image is used only for this request and is not saved into your cloud documents. Continuing means you agree to upload it.
